oasdiff_missing: oasdiff is not in the JGates tools image ({detail}). Download the tools of this JGates version (jgates setup); JGates never installs a tool on your machine.
oasdiff_probe_failed: oasdiff at {path} did not answer --version. Reinstall it from https://github.com/oasdiff/oasdiff/releases.
oasdiff_no_spec: No OpenAPI specification was found (openapi.yaml, openapi.json, swagger.* ...). Set tools.<instance>.spec to its path.
oasdiff_timeout: oasdiff exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
oasdiff_cancelled: The run was cancelled; oasdiff was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
oasdiff_invalid_output: The oasdiff output is not the expected breaking-changes JSON: {detail}
oasdiff_no_invocation: The plan has no oasdiff invocation for the instance {tool}.
oasdiff_reference_none: no reference configured (the stage is blocked until baseRef or baseSpec is set)
oasdiff_condition_fail_on: Changes of level {level} or higher block.
oasdiff_limitation_reference: oasdiff: without a reference revision or file there is nothing to compare, so the stage is blocked, never passed; a specification added after the reference is blocked too.
oasdiff_reference_unset: No reference to compare with: set tools.<instance>.baseRef (a git ref) or baseSpec (a file).
oasdiff_reference_file_missing: The reference file {file} does not exist.
oasdiff_reference_ref_missing: The reference revision {ref} does not exist in this repository (a shallow clone may need to fetch it).
oasdiff_reference_spec_missing: The specification {spec} does not exist in the reference revision {ref}, so there is nothing to compare with.
oasdiff_setting_path: The {key} of the instance {tool} is {value}; use a relative path inside the project.
oasdiff_setting_base_ref: The baseRef of the instance {tool} is {value}; use a git branch, tag, commit or HEAD~N.
oasdiff_setting_both: The instance {tool} sets both baseRef and baseSpec; choose one reference.
oasdiff_setting_fail_on: The failOn of the instance {tool} is {value}; use one of: {allowed}.
oasdiff_form_spec_help: The current specification of the project. Empty: JGates looks for openapi.yaml, openapi.json or swagger.* in the root and in api/, docs/ and spec/.
oasdiff_form_baseRef_help: Branch, tag or commit that holds the previous version of the same file, for example main or origin/main.
oasdiff_form_baseSpec_help: A file of the project with the previous version of the specification.
oasdiff_form_base_help: oasdiff reports the breaking changes between the reference and the current specification. Choose where the reference comes from.
oasdiff_form_base_ref: A Git ref (branch, tag or commit)
oasdiff_form_base_ref_help: Recommended: the specification as it is on the main branch. The ref must exist in this repository.
oasdiff_form_base_spec_help: When the previous version is kept as a file in the project.
oasdiff_form_failOn_help: Which level of change makes the check fail.
oasdiff_form_fail_on_ERR_help: Fails only on changes that break existing clients.
oasdiff_form_fail_on_WARN_help: Also fails on changes that may break clients.
oasdiff_form_capabilities_help: A profile turns checks on by capability: with this, the strict profile (or any profile with API compatibility) runs this instance.
